display_title: The Handsome Male Lead Is a Big Problem
description:
Elias, the male protagonist of a novel that begins with war, saves the world with war, and ends with war.
The survival of this world depends on him. But... the father of this male protagonist is... my young master? 

I thought my memories of Korea were from a past life, but it turns out I've been transmigrated into a novel. To ensure the male lead is born safely and prevents the world's destruction, it's crucial for young master Cherid to meet his destined partner! Only by ensuring the safe birth of Karden Elias can we stop the foretold apocalypse! ...And I also need to change the young master’s fate! 

However, when I started keeping my distance to help him connect with his fated partner— 

*“Why aren’t you following me today?”
“Why weren’t you around all day yesterday?”
“That necklace isn’t the one I gave you.”
“Don’t tell me, Aileen, you...”* 

The young master started saying strange things. 

*“You haven’t found someone else besides me, have you?”* 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
